params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of records per page (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: limit
params.description: Alias for per_page - number of records per page

params.name: limit_max
params.description: Maximum number of records per page (overrides limit if not set)

params.name: count
params.description: Set to 'true' to include total count in pagy metadata (data.pagy.count). Use for count/total queries instead of paginating through all pages.

params.name: q
params.description: Ransack query parameters for filtering. In query strings, use bracket notation: q[name_cont]=john&q[status_eq]=active&q[s]=name+asc. Keys are attribute names with predicates: _cont (contains), _eq (equals), _in (array membership), _gteq (>=), _lteq (<=), _present (not null), _null (is null). The "s" key sorts results (e.g., q[s]=created_at+desc). Example query string: ?q[name_cont]=john&q[s]=name+asc filters names containing "john" sorted by name ascending.
